hair.purpose: 连续前发、下段发尾、独立后发及位于臂后的耳后侧发片

ahoge.purpose: 独立呆毛与连续头顶补底、短点击冲量

expression.purpose: 眼部差分、独立眉毛、慌张挤眼和晕乎圈圈眼
expression.parent: current standing or seated head/face; visible forehead clip

seated.purpose: 原坐姿与仅双臂自然下垂的晕乎坐姿
seated.parent: seated body own alpha; same registration and foot baseline

skirt.purpose: 前裙覆盖腿，后内衬限定下半身
skirt.parent: body space; skirt front before visible legs

wing.purpose: 独立翼、背后翼根、情绪与拖拽振翅
wing.parent: wing roots separate from hair fill

host.parent: host kit/loadImage/model; never extra registration fetch
